evidence: Spectrophotometry, X-ray diffraction, Rutherford backscattering spectroscopy and nuclear reaction analysis were used to determine the chemical and physical characteristics of the films. The crystal structure and crystallite orientation were determined by X-ray diffraction (XRD) measurements with a Philips powder diffractometer MPD 1880 using Cu Ks radiation. Surface morphology was characterized by a JEOL JSEM-820 scanning electron microscope at the Department of Electron Microscopy, University of Helsinki.
